name: Lightner Y Achievers
what_you_do: Teens meet in small groups to explore education and career options, do community service, and take college and industry tours (high school students tour universities each spring break).
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 12. Locations are shared directly with participants.
pay_detail: $217 per year (Members) or $228 per year (Participants). Financial assistance is available through a separate form.
duration: Biweekly Saturday summits, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., September 2026 to May 2027
deadline_text: No application or registration deadline stated. College tour registration opens in early 2027.
how_to_apply: Register through the program's online registration page. Questions: yo.sobha@ymcatriangle.org.
notes: Achievers may earn certified community service hours and may receive partial scholarships as seniors. The page does not say which cities host groups.
